summary: This bill extends from September 30, 2025, to September 30, 2031, the exemption that lets certain alternative fuel and clean vehicles use HOV lanes under 23 U.S.C. 166.

scores.thoughts: The bill extends an HOV lane exemption for alternative fuel vehicles but contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budget authority. It is a regulatory extension only.
No tax provisions, credits, or revenue measures appear in the bill text.
The legislation addresses highway lane access rules and has no connection to healthcare policy or systems.
Completely unrelated to firearms regulation or Second Amendment issues.
No immigration, border, or visa provisions are present.
No provisions touching reproductive rights or abortion access.
No military, defense, or national security spending or policy elements.

The bill extends an existing exemption allowing alternative fuel and clean vehicles to access HOV lanes, providing a continued incentive for lower-emission vehicles. This represents a modest pro-environmental policy continuation but is narrow in scope.
No welfare, entitlement, or social assistance programs are addressed.
